verdict.rationale: Asana's own docs show that projects and tasks can be created and managed (asana-docs-35) and that status updates can be read through the API (asana-docs-4, asana-docs-9). That evidences tracking work items with status. Nothing in the pack documents a priority attribute, assigning an owning team, or an initiative/portfolio-level construct. Missing for 10: documented priority fields, team ownership of initiatives, an initiative/portfolio tracking feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
